Package net.sourceforge.plantuml.ngdot.model

Class DotSubgraph

java.lang.Object
net.sourceforge.plantuml.ngdot.model.DotSubgraph
public final class DotSubgraph extends Object
A subgraph of a DOT graph, or the root graph itself.

Three sets of attributes live here, following Graphviz (cgraph):

  • the graph attributes of this subgraph (graph [...] or name=value statements). A new subgraph starts with a copy of the current graph attributes of its parent: this is why a label set at the top of a graph shows up on every cluster defined after it;
  • the node defaults and edge defaults written in this subgraph (node [...], edge [...]). They are a view over the defaults of the parent: a lookup not found here goes up the chain, and it is done when a node or edge is created.
Nodes and edges are listed in their global creation order, as cgraph iterates them, whatever the order in which they entered this subgraph.
